study.comparator: insulin glargine titrated (sitagliptin third arm not entered, DPP-4 comparator under decision D-X7)
study.notes: STUDY: Light-On (NCT02147925), a 26 week open label active controlled parallel group multicentre trial at 10 centres in China; 75 patients with type 2 diabetes and NAFLD inadequately controlled on metformin randomised 1:1:1 to add on liraglutide (n 24), sitagliptin (n 27) or insulin glargine (n 24), intention to treat population, 65 completers. The liraglutide versus insulin glargine contrast is entered (one contrast per trial, non incretin comparator); the sitagliptin arm is a DPP-4 comparator held under decision D-X7 and is available if that decision admits it. Table 2 prints baseline, week 26 and the change per arm as mean plus or minus SD, so the change columns are the rows (route arm_sds); adiponectin in the exploratory table prints baseline and week 26 as mean plus or minus SD with the change as a median and interquartile range, so that row uses the baseline and week 26 means (route arm_change_imputed_r, correlation 0.5). Subcutaneous adipose tissue fell most with liraglutide but is outside the inventory. MRI-PDFF is the intrahepatic lipid measure of the trial (IDEAL IQ) and enters as liver_fat_pdff. pct_weight_change from the Table 2 body weight row, liraglutide change minus 3.6 kg on a baseline of 86.6 kg equals minus 4.2 percent (insulin glargine minus 1.2 kg on 85.6 kg, minus 1.4 percent; the table marks the between group difference with a dagger but prints no numeric contrast, so amendment A2 takes the treatment arm percent). The printed change of minus 3.6 kg differs by 0.1 kg from the difference of the printed arm means (86.6 to 82.9). Supported by investigator initiated trial research funds from Novo Nordisk and three public grants (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall some_concerns

rows.notes: Table 2 MRI-PDFF: liraglutide 15.4 plus or minus 5.6 to 12.5 plus or minus 6.4 (change minus 4.0 plus or minus 4.5, dagger for a significant between group difference versus insulin glargine), insulin glargine 14.9 plus or minus 5.5 to 14.1 plus or minus 7.3 (change minus 0.8 plus or minus 5.3)
Table 2 VAT cm2 by MRI: liraglutide change minus 20.9 plus or minus 23.3 (dagger), insulin glargine plus 9.5 plus or minus 33.9
Table 2 HbA1c percent: liraglutide 7.8 to 6.8 (change minus 1.0 plus or minus 0.9), insulin glargine 7.7 to 6.9 (change minus 0.7 plus or minus 1.3)
Table 2 FPG mmol/L change per arm
Table 2 ALT, labelled mmol/L in the table but an aminotransferase activity in U/L; change per arm
Table 2 AST, labelled mmol/L in the table but an aminotransferase activity in U/L; change per arm

exploratory endpoint table: adiponectin baseline and week 26 per arm as mean plus or minus SD (liraglutide 10.81 plus or minus 9.89 to 17.77 plus or minus 5.36, insulin glargine 14.75 plus or minus 9.18 to 13.57 plus or minus 9.34); the change column of that table is a median with interquartile range (3.82 (0, 8.73) versus 0.33 (minus 1.71, 5.06)), so the imputed change route is used on the arm means; the unit is printed mg/mL, which is three orders from the usual microgram per millilitre, and is recorded as printed

json.design: 26 week open label active controlled parallel group multicentre trial, add on liraglutide versus sitagliptin versus insulin glargine on metformin, 75 patients with type 2 diabetes and NAFLD, intention to treat
json.reason: full text group (Europe PMC); twelve inventory markers with change per arm and SD in Table 2, plus adiponectin from the exploratory table by the imputed change route; the liraglutide versus insulin glargine contrast is entered
other_markers: body weight, BMI and waist circumference

rob.justification: randomised 1:1:1 across 10 centres with balanced baseline characteristics (D1 low); open label, and the comparator is titrated basal insulin, so behaviour and dose adjustment differ by arm without blinding (D2 high); intention to treat with 65 of 75 completing and non completers classified as having no improvement for the imaging endpoints, a conservative but non standard imputation (D3 some concerns); MRI IDEAL IQ and central laboratory measures (D4 low); registered trial with its prespecified primary (intrahepatic lipid) and the full table of secondary endpoints reported (D5 low)

doubts: the sitagliptin arm is a DPP-4 inhibitor comparator and would give a second contrast for every row; held under decision D-X7 with LYDIA and Suzuki 2014
AST and ALT are labelled mmol/L in Table 2, which is wrong for an aminotransferase activity; entered as U/L with the printed values
adiponectin is printed in mg/mL, three orders above the usual scale, and its baseline differs between the two arms by 36 percent
non completers were classified as having no improvement in the imaging endpoints, so the MRI-PDFF and VAT rows are conservative
pct_weight_change minus 4.2 percent is arithmetic from the printed change and baseline and is expected to be flagged by the numbers check
